🎬 F1: The Movie (2025)

F1: The Movie follows Sonny Hayes, a former Formula One racing prodigy whose promising career was cut short after a devastating accident. Decades later, Sonny gets an unexpected opportunity to return to the world of Formula One when his old friend Ruben Cervantes, the owner of a struggling racing team, recruits him to help save the organization from collapse. Joining the fictional APXGP team, Sonny finds himself competing alongside Joshua Pearce, a talented and ambitious young driver determined to establish himself as the future of racing. As their contrasting personalities create tension both on and off the track, the two drivers must learn to work together while facing fierce competition, dangerous races, and the enormous pressure of professional motorsport. Through intense rivalries, personal struggles, and breathtaking racing sequences, Sonny discovers that experience, determination, and teamwork can be just as important as raw talent. Combining spectacular racing action, emotional storytelling, and thrilling competition, the film explores redemption, ambition, mentorship, and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Action • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 36m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Joseph Kosinski

🏆 Recognition: Starring Brad Pitt, Damson Idris, Javier Bardem, and Kerry Condon, the film became a major box-office success, earning over $630 million worldwide. Filmed during actual Formula One Grand Prix weekends and produced with the involvement of seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton, it received four Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture, and won the 2026 Oscar for Best Sound.
